messages:
morgan: P1 - ACME reporting a spike of 503s from hosted inference (/v1/generate). Customer case 78921. They saw immediate failures for ~30m. I pulled the raw runner logs and there are GPU pagefault / SIGILL entries followed by container restart. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/hosted-infer/cluster?orgId=1 (span 09:10-09:40 UTC)

infra-bot: detected container_restart - worker-23 (node=gpu-4) exit_signal=SIGILL exit_code=132

jordan: oncall here, looking now. which model + config?

morgan: model: llama-13b-qlora-q8 (redwood/llama-13b:q8-2026-02-12), batch_size from customer = 16, seq_limit=4096. They did a model swap ~09:12 UTC to the quantized variant.

lee: grabbing logs from node gpu-4, tail: 
```
[09:13:02] infer_runner[pid=4112]: KV prefetch start seq_len=4096 batch=16
[09:13:02] cuda: page fault at 0x7f8a3c000000, reason=invalid-mapping
[09:13:02] infer_runner: illegal instruction (SIGILL) pc=0x7f9b5f21a2
[09:13:02] kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[09:13:03] supervisor: container worker-23 exited code=132 signal=SIGILL
```

lee: also saw host OOM messages right before the SIGILL on that host: host mem from 64GB -> >120GB due to large kv prefetch allocation.

tanvi: q8 models can increase CPU-side staging memory due to dequant/decompress buffers. Did customer enable kv_prefetch=true?

morgan: yes they confirmed kv_prefetch=true in their request template.

jordan: action plan: (1) try to reproduce on staging with same image+config (tanvi). (2) immediate mitigation: route traffic to fallback model /model/redwood/llama-13b-fp16 and throttle batchsize to 4. (3) eng-runtime to triage SIGILL kernel. Assigning lee/jordan to coordinate.

customer_success: can we tell the customer a short mitigation? they are on a paid Dedicated trial and very nervous.

jordan: tell them were routing to a fallback model and reducing batchsize; should cut 503s within 5-10m. Offer a call.

lee: repro attempt notes: created staging pod with same image sha sha256:ad3f9c, kv_prefetch=true, batch=16, seq=4096. After ~2 attempts got the same sequence: large host alloc then GPU pagefault -> SIGILL. Stack shows a JIT compiled kernel failing in nvrtc: 
```
E 0x7f9b5f21a2 nvrtc_kernel.cu line 241: illegal instruction during vectorized attention kernel
host_alloc: requested 38GB, available 34GB -> host swap thrash
```

lee: attaching trimmed gdb backtrace (pc values):
```
#0 0x7f9b5f21a2 in nvrtc_launch
#1 0x7f9b4f112b in attention_kernel
#2 0x557f3ab2c in run_forward
```

lee: hypothesis: quantized kernel codegen + extremely long seq + large batch is triggering a host-side staging path that overflows memory, and then the JITted PTX uses an instruction set not supported by driver on that instance (SIGILL). Could be a codegen/driver mismatch or stale cuda/driver combo on gpu-4.

morgan: customer wants ETA. jordan/lee any timeline?

jordan: immediate: mitigation applied (traffic routed -> fallback model, batchsize 4). Monitoring now. Medium-term: eng-runtime needs to reproduce and produce a driver-safe kernel or add guard rails to refuse kv_prefetch for q8 when host_mem < X.

tanvi: I reproduced locally on a c6g-like shape but with older nvidia driver (470.x) and saw SIGILL; with driver 525.x no SIGILL (but still high host mem). So driver mismatch + kernel vectorization seems likely.

lee: short-term fix options: (A) pin hosted nodes serving q8 to driver 525+ only, (B) refuse kv_prefetch when batch*seq > threshold, (C) add fallback that streams KV without staging whole batch. I recommend combining A+B for fastest customer relief.

jordan: agreed. Lee can you coordinate a patch to the router to implement routing rule to driver=525 nodes and set threshold? Tanvi can you add a safe check in the runner to disable kv_prefetch when predicted host alloc > 32GB.

lee: creating ENG ticket INF-4521 (eng-runtime) with logs and repro steps. will start canary rollout for routing rule to 5% of hosted capacity.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: route-rule=q8-driver-525-only -> 5% capacity (start=09:58 UTC)

morgan: updated customer: applied fallback routing and batch throttle; they report reduced errors to near 0 in the last 7m. Scheduled 10:30 UTC call to walk through root cause and timeline.

customer_success: +1 customer acknowledged, wants follow-up changelog item and driver requirements documented.

tanvi: follow-up: Ill open a PR to add a runtime guard that estimates host staging memory and disables kv_prefetch when it exceeds safe limits. Will include unit test and a small e2e that reproduces the SIGILL on staging with older driver.

lee: ops follow-up: scan fleet for nodes with driver < 520 and mark them in the env to avoid serving q8 images until we can rollout drivers. Will post roll plan once I have the list.

jordan: thanks all. keeping thread open until INF-4521 has a patch and canary shows green for 24h.

morgan: noted, will keep customer updated. closing interim while we monitor. :raised_hands:
